reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model PA-10, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.

The claimed purchase date of 2020-05-16 is before the program's sale window, which runs from 2021-06-01 to 2023-11-30. A purchase before the window is denied, even though the retailer (Sweetwater Sound) is listed.
The date code 2126 is within the recalled range of 2126 to 2319.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one, so the flag rule does not apply.
